description: Check which clients, past clients, or referral sources a consultant has gone too long without talking to. Sorts contacts by days of silence into healthy (<30 days), cooling (30+), neglected (60+), and urgent (90+), with a suggested next step for each and an overall network health score. Use when someone asks who to follow up with or worries their pipeline is drying up. Returns a link that opens Retainer's free BD neglect detector with these contacts.

last_contact.description: Date of the last real conversation, YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: Contact name, optionally with company, e.g. "Sarah Chen (Aldgate Finance)".

name: find_neglected_relationships
title: Find neglected client relationships
